test.description: Same as geojson-z0/geojson-crossing-z0, but with regular vector tiles instead of a GeoJSON source: tile generators also duplicate geometry near the antimeridian into the zoom 0 tile buffer (shifted by 360 degrees), so the clip must apply to all vector sources. Tiles generated with `tippecanoe -z3 --no-tile-compression -e tiles repro.geojson` from two polygons (lon 170..180 and lon 170..190), then renamed to z-x-y.mvt.
